original_cohort: Same 101 original OEF equity share classes from June30 2015, public Sep2 2015
data_improvement: Restore independently verified original-identity pretermination histories and split/cash events; retain unknown labels across unsupported merger/terminal outcomes
history_start: 2014-01-01 where verified; shorter recovered histories retain warm-up gaps

factor_reference.score: unchanged v1 fixed four-factor score; not inverted

momentum_12_1.score: positive 252-session momentum skipping most recent20 sessions; fixed economic baseline

gbm_rank_3y.estimator: LightGBM regression of cross-sectional rank labels

gbm_rank_5y.estimator: LightGBM regression of cross-sectional rank labels

learning_target: Within each date/horizon: average_rank/N - (N+1)/(2N); exactly zero-centered cross-sectional rank labels, minimum20 valid outcomes; unknown endpoints absent
fold_fit_end: December31 two years before evaluation year, with every training label ending before calibration starts
fold_calibration: Calendar year immediately before evaluation year; labels mature by final session of that year
fold_training_window: 3 or5 calendar years ending before calibration, truncated at2016; no postfit window tuning
preprocessing: Same-day available-cohort feature ranks; training-only Ridge standardization; equal date weights; no missing-feature imputation from future
selection_rule: Highest equally weighted mean of five annual common-row/common-date20-session ICs; report median, worst year, positive-year count and paired reference differences
shared_evaluation_policy: Minimum20 mature observations; constant score zero; one identical date set for all candidates within each fold
final_calibration: Per-horizon held-out logistic probability calibration; nonnegative-slope affine mean-return calibration; empirical log1p residual intervals scaled by contemporaneous historical volatility
recent_diagnostic: 2025-01-01 through2026-09-30 already viewed in experiment1; reuse is explicitly posthoc, not a fresh independent holdout
prohibited_response_to_diagnostic: No sign inversion, feature/hyperparameter retuning, candidate substitution or universe filtering based on2025–2026 results
latest_refit: Selected window length immediately before calibration_start2025-10-01, no earlier than2016; calibration through2026-09-30, four separate horizons; no out-of-sample claim
portfolio: Unchanged next-session monthly long-only USD policy, 95% target,10 slots,15/30bps per side,1% trading-value-proxy participation; unknown held values invalidate path performance
end_condition: Complete the bounded6-candidate5-fold comparison, one reused recent diagnostic, evidence-backed recovered-data audit, truthful report and artifacts; unresolved public-source gaps are documented rather than guessed
evaluation_label_cutoff: Every annual fold only scores outcomes with label_end no later than that year final session; late-year predictions retained as immature
target_universe: Candidate-independent eligible original-cohort date/horizon observations with finite return>=-1 and positive raw sigma, regardless candidate feature missingness; minimum20 labels; average ties; exact zero centering

recovered_adjustment.formula: source-adjusted gross price return = split_ratio_new_per_old * raw_close_t / (raw_close_prev - cash_usd_per_pre_event_share_t)
recovered_adjustment.implementation: calendar-based cumulative multiplicative factor; event prior-session valid raw close required
recovered_adjustment.volume: source-reported shares; raw close times raw volume is trading-value proxy; split-adjusted OHLC and reciprocal volume preserve product
recovered_adjustment.missing_sessions: reindex full shared calendar; no horizon compression or quote forward fill
recovered_adjustment.cross_source_disagreement_policy: Retain provenance for all discrepancies; mask quote as unknown if absolute close difference exceeds0.1% of source close or OHLC/volume invalid; no replacement based on which price performs better
recovered_adjustment.event_completeness: Only explicitly accepted source intervals and event ledgers; reconstructed-with-limits is not complete independently verified action history
recovered_adjustment.terminal: No labels with endpoint after last verified original quote; no presumed acquirer substitution or cash liquidation

calibration_details.probability: LogisticRegression C1,random_state42,max_iter1000, binary log loss with equal date weights
calibration_details.mean_return: weighted least squares affine score transform with slope constrained>=0; zero score variance gives slope0 and mean offset
calibration_details.interval: unweighted empirical log1p residual order statistics q10,q50,q90, scaled by historical sigma*sqrt(h); invalid point<=-1 or sigma excluded and counted
calibration_details.minimum_samples: at least30 training and30 calibration rows per horizon; calibration has both positive/nonpositive outcomes
calibration_details.invalid_outputs: independent task availability; out-of-domain/crossed/nonfinite outputs remain unavailable, never clipped or re-sorted
calibration_details.training_weights: inverse eligible feature-usable rows per date normalized to mean1

nested_walk_forward.rule: For each outer year, pick kind using only mean annual common-IC from listed earlier inner years; evaluate that already-predefined candidate on outer-year predictions. No outer-year outcomes enter its own selection. Report this causal selection path separately from final six-candidate development comparison.
nested_walk_forward.final_architecture: After nested diagnostics, use all five2020–2024 development folds under unchanged mean-IC rule; 2025–2026 remains reused only
